role_sought: Member of the Chamber of Deputies (ANO list leader, Prague)
vote_share: ANO 18.65% (927,240 votes); Babiš 18,955 preference votes (19.62% of ANO's Prague vote)
detail: First election contested by ANO; led to the ČSSD–ANO–KDU-ČSL coalition in which Babiš became Finance Minister. Voting held 25–26 October 2013.

role_sought: Member of the Chamber of Deputies (ANO list leader, Central Bohemian Region); prime-ministerial candidate
detail: Voting held 20–21 October 2017; Babiš received the most preference votes of any elected candidate and was appointed Prime Minister on 6 December 2017.

role_sought: Member of the Chamber of Deputies (ANO list leader, Ústí nad Labem Region); re-election as Prime Minister
result: Elected as MP; ANO won most seats (72) but lost power
opponent: SPOLU coalition (ODS, KDU-ČSL, TOP 09) 27.79%; Pirates and Mayors (PirStan)
detail: Voting held 8–9 October 2021. SPOLU and PirStan formed a majority government under Petr Fiala; Babiš became leader of the opposition.
Nominated by deputies; he finished second in the first round behind Petr Pavel (35.40%) and lost the run-off.

role_sought: Member of the Chamber of Deputies (ANO list leader, Moravian-Silesian Region); prime-ministerial candidate
vote_share: ANO 34.51% (1,940,507 votes); Babiš 72,119 preference votes (26.50% of ANO's regional vote)
opponent: SPOLU coalition (ODS, KDU-ČSL, TOP 09) led by Petr Fiala, second with 23.36% (52 seats)
detail: Voting held 3–4 October 2025. ANO formed a coalition with SPD and Motoristé sobě (108 of 200 seats); Babiš was appointed Prime Minister on 9 December 2025.
